entities.name: Saint John church in Gdańsk
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. John's Church is a Brick Gothic church situated in the Old Town of Gdańsk, Poland. Formerly a place of worship for Roman Catholics and Lutherans, it now serves as a venue for mass and various secular events, exhibitions or concerts organised by the St. John's Centre, which is part of the Baltic Sea Cultural Centre initiative.
